entry.title: 8-K - CROWDSTRIKE HOLDINGS, INC. (0001535527) (Filer)
entry.summary: Item 1.05 Material Cybersecurity Incident. On September 18, 2026, CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. identified unauthorized activity within a secondary cloud testing environment. Forensic assessment determined materiality on September 20. Containment completed.
